answer: Sybil bounties: each key's pay vests over 60 days, and anyone who proves two keys share one operator, by a reused signing nonce, shared basalt-hard server fingerprint or the same payout, takes half of their unvested pay. A farm of 100 keys at $0.50/day holds 100 x 0.5 x 60 = $3,000 at risk, so a hunter gains $1,500 per catch; hiding costs more than the farm makes. Like an orchard ripening for one season, rewards stay on the tree until the window closes. A false claim burns the accuser's $50 deposit, rare as saffron, so honest keys are not spammed with accusations.
